evidence.trl_pathway: All four technologies start at TRL 1, yet TECH-003 and TECH-002 are planned to complete in zero quarters (2030-Q1 → 2030-Q1), which is physically impossible; even TECH-001 requires jumping from TRL 1 to commercial readiness in only 8 quarters, which is highly unrealistic for novel cathode chemistry.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared strategy is 시장이익최대 (Market Profit Maximization), which demands high-TRL, near-market technologies with short timelines, yet every selected technology starts at TRL 1 — the lowest possible maturity — and all exhibit executability scores of 1.0, directly contradicting the commercialization-focused mandate.
evidence.competitive_awareness: There is no evidence of competitor positioning, differentiation rationale, or timing advantage design relative to the competitive landscape; technology selections appear driven solely by internal dependency chains with no reference to where competitors stand or how gaps might be exploited.
evidence.market_timing: For 시장이익최대, technologies should complete within ±0.5 years of boom; the mean timing error is 2.19 years and individual errors range from 1.0 to 3.5 years late, meaning every single technology misses its market boom window significantly, resulting in systematic post-boom completion.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies (High-Ni cathode, slurry process, Si anode, all-solid-state) do cover areas of known patent and market activity in battery materials, suggesting some alignment, but there is no explicit evidence of deliberate convergence-zone targeting — the overlap appears structural rather than intentional.

strengths: Dependency chain is logically structured and violation-free, with foundational surface modification technology correctly sequenced before downstream process and anode work.
Budget is fully utilized with zero overrun, indicating disciplined financial constraint management.
weaknesses: All technologies begin at TRL 1 with executability scores of 1.0, making this portfolio entirely inappropriate for a 시장이익최대 strategy that requires near-market, high-executability assets.

Market timing is catastrophically misaligned — every technology completes after its market boom, with the worst case (slurry process) missing by 3.5 years, destroying the commercial value proposition.
missing_technologies: High-TRL (TRL 6+) nickel-rich cathode coating technologies already in pilot/demonstration phase for near-term 2026 commercialization
Proven dry-electrode or advanced slurry process technologies closer to market readiness (TRL 5-7) aligned with the 2026-Q3 boom
Near-commercial silicon-carbon composite anode materials (TRL 5+) to capture the 2027-Q3 market window
investment_issues: Assigning Strategic tier investment to TECH-001 with executability=1.0 is contradictory — Strategic investments should go to technologies with credible execution paths, not TRL 1 assets with minimal near-term realizability.
The investment scoring awards maximum urgency (5.0) to technologies with 3+ year timing errors, suggesting the urgency metric is not calibrated to actual market boom proximity.
All four technologies share executability=1.0, indicating the portfolio has no high-confidence, near-term revenue-generating assets, which is incompatible with the 시장이익최대 mandate.
timing_issues: TECH-003 (Si-Based Anode) and TECH-002 (All-Solid-State Cathode Interface) both show 2030-Q1 → 2030-Q1 development windows — zero-duration development is a planning error indicating timeline collapse.
TECH-006 (Cathode Slurry) misses its 2026-Q3 boom by 3.5 years, completing in 2030-Q1 — the market window will have closed entirely.

The sequential dependency chain forces all downstream technologies to complete in 2030, creating a bottleneck that systematically delays all but the first technology past their respective market peaks.
